resources.string: Review sharing the CPU timing setting
Share once: CPU timing is ON. Send only this EON setting to the assistant card? Tap again to confirm. No measurements or screen contents.
Share once: CPU timing is OFF. Send only this EON setting to the assistant card? Tap again to confirm. No measurements or screen contents.
EON controls shared: CPU timing ON. Check model profile in controls to measure this process. No screen contents collected.
EON controls shared: CPU timing OFF. Check model profile in controls without measuring this process. No screen contents collected.
Shared setting unavailable. Screen layout and screenshot collection are always off.
Selection canceled. EON is not the selected assistant.
The mic is optional. Start measures six seconds of local microphone levels. Stop, collapse or dismiss to stop and clear. No audio saved or sent. The built-in tone check does not use the mic.
Optional microphone meter: request Android microphone permission here. This does not start listening.
Mic off. An existing grant alone cannot enable the meter. Deny EON microphone access in Android Settings, then request permission here (before choosing EON as assistant if needed).
Permission reviewed. Only Start in an unlocked assistant card or in floating HUD controls can turn the mic on.
Mic off. Use Open EON controls to review microphone permission, then invoke a fresh card.

Use your assistant gesture while unlocked. Hardware hotwords are unsupported by EON: Android 12 and later do not expose the detector or enrollment check to ordinary apps. EON does not listen for a wake word. Expand the card to check a profile or explicitly start the microphone meter.
